subject: blueprints/us-equities/adaptive-paper/corporate_actions.py AlpacaCorporateActionsSource.fetch
method: Coordinator ran the source's fetch() against Alpaca's corporate-actions data endpoint with the host's dedicated paper account keys (loaded through adaptive-paper runner.credentials from the alpaca-paper inventory entry; never printed). Read-only market-data requests; no orders.

queries.expected: no corporate action in the window

CRITICAL finding 1 (fix round, 2026-09-24): this is the guard's actual PRE-FIX production window -- today..next_session around the real 2024-08-12 ex-date -- proving the endpoint filters by process date (a cash dividend's payable date, typically 1-3 weeks after ex_date), not ex_date, so a narrow window systematically misses a real dividend it should have caught
queries.note: negative result -- confirms the bug, not a mismatch against an expected action

queries.expected: AAPL quarterly cash dividend, ex-date 2024-08-12 -- re-check with the FIXED window logic (runner._corporate_action_fetch_window: anchor-7d .. anchor+90d, matching CORPORATE_ACTION_FETCH_WINDOW_PAST_DAYS/FUTURE_DAYS), which recovers the same dividend the narrow window above missed

claim_boundary: Confirms that the live Alpaca source returns and normalizes these historical windows correctly (type and governing date), AND that the guard's original today..next_session fetch window was too narrow to reliably observe a real dividend (Alpaca's endpoint filters by process/payable date, not the ex_date this guard's evaluate_guard logic checks against) -- see corporate-actions-native-check-20260924's negative_query row above and blueprints/us-equities/alpaca-historical/README.md:35-36/collect.py:202-204 for the documented endpoint behaviour this reflects. The 2026-09-24 fix round widens the fetch window to anchor-7d..anchor+90d (runner.py's CORPORATE_ACTION_FETCH_WINDOW_PAST_DAYS/FUTURE_DAYS) and filters locally on the governing date in evaluate_guard, which the wide-window re-check row above confirms recovers the dividend. This check still does not exercise the guard inside a running paper trial end-to-end, a multi-day overnight resume against the live endpoint, the refresh cadence against the endpoint's rate limits, or action types other than forward split and cash dividend -- and a single historical dividend's 1-3-week process-date lag is not proof that every action type's process-date lag fits within the fixed 90-day forward pad.
not_retained: The raw API responses and the exact command line were not retained; the observed values above are the complete normalized output.
